description: This file contains a comprehensive set of tests for a Lua interpreter, including tests for command-line options, environment variables, BOM handling, argument passing, warnings, error handling, and signal interruption.

methods.name: prepfile
methods.description: Creates or overwrites a file with specified content, optionally in binary mode.

methods.name: getoutput
methods.description: Reads the content of the output temporary file and deletes it.

methods.name: checkprogout
methods.description: Checks if the output matches expected lines.

methods.name: checkout
methods.description: Verifies if the output matches expected string.

methods.name: RUN
methods.description: Executes a command with 'lua' replacing 'lua' with the program name.

methods.name: NoRun
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail and checks for specific error messages.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Replaces ';;' in LUA_PATH with default path and verifies output.

methods.name: kill
methods.description: Sends an interrupt signal to a process by pid.

methods.name: runback
methods.description: Runs a Lua script in background and returns its output file handle and pid.
